status: PREDECLARED before any fleet submission of this study (committed ahead of the runs). Immutable; results go to new records.
scope: exploratory feasibility; canonical design/netlist unchanged; DR-009 stays proposed; no spec target is changed

op_record_superseded.sim/offset-capability/records/20261010-1: first run of the same probe; identical OP, but its derived systematic_vos_estimate_v has the wrong sign (tool bug fixed before the second run). Kept, not used.

grid0.why: reference: canonical sizing snapped to the 0.005 um grid only (4.634->4.635, 7.819->7.820); isolates the grid snap from the resizes

m2p1.why: mirror-only: PMOS group W,L x2 (area x4), pair unchanged; tests the mirror-only path and exposes the input-pair floor

m2p2.why: balanced moderate: PMOS group and pair both W,L x2 (area x4 each)

m4p2.why: largest bounded step along the area-optimal direction (mirror area factor ~ 5.7x the pair's, see `bounds`): PMOS x4 (area x16), pair x2 (area x4)

candidate_count_bound: 3 sizing candidates (m2p1, m2p2, m4p2) + 1 grid-only reference (grid0). No candidate is added after results are seen; a follow-up needs a new plan.

monte_carlo.seed_pairing: seed 20261085 = chunk 0 of #85 (tt) and of #107; per-sample seeds equal the canonical run's first 100 samples
monte_carlo.retry: capacity refusals only (offset_probe default 300 s wait); any other failure is recorded, not retried locally
monte_carlo.statistical_label: EXPLORATORY: N=100 at tt / 27 C / 1.8 V only. Relative standard error of sigma 7.1 % (1 SE). Not the N>=300 + corners basis of DR-009; no compliance claim is made from it.
monte_carlo.dut_snapshot: offset_probe captures each candidate once into records/dut-<label>/ (sha256 recorded in every chunk summary)

pvt.grid: 5 corners x 3 temperatures, paired supplies (the canonical record 20261010-103340-ba1dfa8-0241c1 grid)
pvt.canonical_reference: sim/opamp-characterization/records/20261010-103340-ba1dfa8-0241c1 (fleet, same command, canonical DUT before the XRz 9.763->9.765 grid snap; grid0 is the like-for-like reference)

predeclared_checks.mc_vs_prediction: measured sigma within +/-25 % of the measured-anchored estimate (2 SE at N=100 is 14 %; the rest is the single-OP hand-calc ratio). Informative only: disagreement is reported, the tolerance is not widened.

targets_unchanged.swing: ~1.39 Vpp at SS/-40 C (currently unmet; regressions reported)

decision_rule.sizing_candidate_supported: some candidate has MC sigma upper 2-SE bound <= 0.275 mV AND open-loop gain, GBW and phase margin meet their targets at all 15 PVT points AND no other ratified row regresses vs grid0.
decision_rule.sizing_insufficient: otherwise. Then the record quantifies the area still required (from the measured candidate sigmas, extrapolated with the Pelgrom area law, with its uncertainty) and the measured PVT/headroom cost trend, and proposes a separately scoped technique study (trim / chopping / auto-zero) instead of a sizing candidate.

inputs.tag: ESTIMATE (first-order Pelgrom area scaling at a fixed operating point)

mirror_only.statement: with the mirror term driven to zero, sigma -> sigma_pair; the pair alone is 11.3x the target, so no mirror size meets it

pair_area_factor_min.note: pair gate area multiplier needed even if the mirror contributed nothing

area_optimal_handcalc_split.note: same optimisation with the Pelgrom hand-calc group sigmas (pair 1.77 mV, mirror 7.08 mV) instead of the measured ones: the model-uncertainty end of the range

mirror_gmid_lever.note: lowering the mirror gm/ID (higher overdrive) divides the mirror term by gm/ID3_old/gm/ID3_new at constant area; even gm/ID = 5 (deep strong inversion, ~400 mV overdrive) is a 2.8x reduction, and the mirror's Vsg rise is taken straight out of the ICMR upper edge (DR-002: 136 mV window at the worst corner) and the XM6 overdrive
